@menspireacademy is the name so many in the barber industry pay attention to. So we went straight to the source with quick fire questions on what it takes to build a hair business with global reach.

The takeaway: it starts at the top. @joshlamonaca leads with intent, and with the right systems running quietly in the background, his team is free to keep building on what they do best.

We asked some of the artists and barbers at HAIRFEST for their hot takes. From trends they're over, what they would ban and what they think needs to change.

Some hair industry rules are ready to be broken. 👀

Could the line between barbering and hairdressing be disappearing?

We asked the artists and educators shaping the future of hair what they believe 2027 will bring. Most agreed the two crafts will continue to merge, with cuts defined less by gender and more by the person in the chair.

A glimpse into where the industry is heading, from those leading it.
